html:
The Battle of Mogadishu was fought on 3 and 4 October 1993, when United States special forces trying to capture aides of the warlord Mohamed Farrah Aidid were trapped in the city after two helicopters were shot down.

US troops had come with a United Nations mission to end the famine of the civil war, which turned into a hunt for Aidid. In the fighting 18 Americans and hundreds of Somalis, many of them civilians, were killed.

The United States withdrew its forces in 1994, and the UN mission ended in 1995. The fear of another Somalia made Western governments unwilling to send troops to stop the Rwandan genocide months later. The battle became widely known through the book and film Black Hawk Down set in Mogadishu.
sum: The Battle of Mogadishu was fought on 3 and 4 October 1993, when United States special forces trying to capture aides of the warlord Mohamed Farrah Aidid were trapped in the city after two helicopters were shot down.
